Maudgalyayana.fact: They made such a resolution since the age of the previous Buddha Aṇomadassī, when Maudgalyāyana was a layman called Sirivadha. Sirivaddha felt inspired to become a chief disciple under a future Buddha after his friend, Śāriputra in a previous life, recommended that he do so.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Afterwards, he and Śāriputra continued to do good deeds for many lifetimes, until the time of _____
Maudgalyayana.fact: Afterwards, he and Śāriputra continued to do good deeds for many lifetimes, until the time of Sakyamuni Buddha.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Maudgalyayana.fact: After the Buddha appoints Maudgalyāyana as chief disciple, he becomes called "Mahā-Maudgalyāyana", mahā meaning 'great'. Post-canonical texts describe Maudgalyāyana as the second chief male disciple, next to Śāriputra.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Moreover, _____āyana is often included in traditional lists of 'four great disciples' (pinyin: sida shengwen) and eight arhats
Maudgalyayana.fact: In Buddhist art en literature, Buddhas are commonly depicted with two main disciples (Japanese: niky ōji, Classical Tibetan: mchog zung) at their side—in the case of Sakyamuni Buddha, the two disciples depicted are most often Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra. Although there are different perspectives among different Buddhist canons as to the merits of each disciple, in all Buddhist canons, Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra are recognized as the two main disciples of the Buddha.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The lives of _____āyana and Śāriputra are closely connected

Despite these widespread patterns in both scripture and archaeological research, it has been noted that in later iconography, Ānanda and Mahākasyapa are depicted much more, and Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra are depicted much less.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In their student years, _____āyana and Śāriputra are co-pupils under the same teacher
Maudgalyayana.fact: The lives of Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra are closely connected. Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra are born on the same day, and die in the same period.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: For example, when Śāriputra falls ill, it is described that _____āyana used his psychic powers to obtain medicine for Śāriputra
Maudgalyayana.fact: In their student years, Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra are co-pupils under the same teacher. For example, when Śāriputra falls ill, it is described that Maudgalyāyana used his psychic powers to obtain medicine for Śāriputra.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Śāriputra is considered the wisest disciple of the Buddha, but _____āyana is second to him in wisdom
Maudgalyayana.fact: For example, when Śāriputra falls ill, it is described that Maudgalyāyana used his psychic powers to obtain medicine for Śāriputra. Śāriputra is considered the wisest disciple of the Buddha, but Maudgalyāyana is second to him in wisdom.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The one thing that gives them a strong bond as spiritual friends is the love for the _____, which both express often
Maudgalyayana.fact: Śāriputra is considered the wisest disciple of the Buddha, but Maudgalyāyana is second to him in wisdom. The one thing that gives them a strong bond as spiritual friends is the love for the Buddha, which both express often.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The Buddha is described in the texts as placing great faith in _____āyana as a teacher
Maudgalyayana.fact: When comparing Śāriputra with Maudgalyāyana, the Buddha uses the metaphor of a woman giving birth to a child for Śāriputra, in that he establishes new students in the first attainment on the spiritual path (Pali: sotāpanna). Maudgalyāyana, however, is compared with the master who trains the child up, in that he develops his students further along the path to enlightenment.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: He often praises _____āyana for his teachings, and sometimes has Maudgalyāyana teach in his place
Maudgalyayana.fact: When comparing Śāriputra with Maudgalyāyana, the Buddha uses the metaphor of a woman giving birth to a child for Śāriputra, in that he establishes new students in the first attainment on the spiritual path (Pali: sotāpanna). Maudgalyāyana, however, is compared with the master who trains the child up, in that he develops his students further along the path to enlightenment.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: On another occasion, the _____ has Maudgalyāyana announce a ban on a group of monks living in Kitigara, whose problematic behavior has become widely known in the area
Maudgalyayana.fact: The Buddha is described in the texts as placing great faith in Maudgalyāyana as a teacher. Maudgalyāyana is also given the responsibility to train Rahula, the Buddha's son.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Furthermore, _____āyana plays a crucial role during the schism caused by the disciple Devadatta
Maudgalyayana.fact: He often praises Maudgalyāyana for his teachings, and sometimes has Maudgalyāyana teach in his place. Maudgalyāyana is also given the responsibility to train Rahula, the Buddha's son.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Through his ability to communicate with devas (god-like beings), he learns that _____ was acting inappropriately
Maudgalyayana.fact: Furthermore, Maudgalyāyana plays a crucial role during the schism caused by the disciple Devadatta. Through his ability to communicate with devas (god-like beings), he learns that Devadatta was acting inappropriately.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: He obtains information that _____ is enjoining Prince Ajātasattu (Pali: Ajātasattu) for help, and the two form a dangerous combination
Maudgalyayana.fact: Furthermore, Maudgalyāyana plays a crucial role during the schism caused by the disciple Devadatta. Through his ability to communicate with devas (god-like beings), he learns that Devadatta was acting inappropriately.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: They then persuade the other monks to return while _____ is asleep
Maudgalyayana.fact: He obtains information that Devadatta is enjoining Prince Ajātasattu (Pali: Ajātasattu) for help, and the two form a dangerous combination. Later, when Devadatta has successfully created a split in the Buddhist community, the Buddha asks Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra to convince Devadatta's following to reunite with the Buddha, which in the Pali account they are able to accomplish.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: After the split off party has successfully been returned to the Buddha, _____āyana expresses astonishment because of Devadatta's actions
Maudgalyayana.fact: Maudgalyāyana therefore informs the Buddha of this. Later, when Devadatta has successfully created a split in the Buddhist community, the Buddha asks Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra to convince Devadatta's following to reunite with the Buddha, which in the Pali account they are able to accomplish.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The Buddha explains that _____ had acted like this habitually, throughout many lifetimes
Maudgalyayana.fact: Later, when Devadatta has successfully created a split in the Buddhist community, the Buddha asks Maudgalyāyana and Śāriputra to convince Devadatta's following to reunite with the Buddha, which in the Pali account they are able to accomplish. They then persuade the other monks to return while Devadatta is asleep.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In the _____ texts of some canons, the effort at persuading the split off monks is met with obstinacy and fails
Maudgalyayana.fact: In the Vinaya texts of some canons, the effort at persuading the split off monks is met with obstinacy and fails.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In teaching, _____āyana relies much on such powers
Maudgalyayana.fact: In teaching, Maudgalyāyana relies much on such powers. Varying accounts in the Pali Canon show Maudgalyāyana travelling to and speaking with pretas (spirits in unhappy destinations) in order to explain to them their horrific conditions.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Varying accounts in the _____ show Maudgalyāyana travelling to and speaking with pretas (spirits in unhappy destinations) in order to explain to them their horrific conditions
Maudgalyayana.fact: Varying accounts in the Pali Canon show Maudgalyāyana travelling to and speaking with pretas (spirits in unhappy destinations) in order to explain to them their horrific conditions.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: He then reports this to the _____, who uses these examples in his teachings
Maudgalyayana.fact: He then reports this to the Buddha, who uses these examples in his teachings.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Similarly, _____āyana is depicted as conversing with devas and brahmas (heavenly beings), and asking devas what deeds they did to be reborn in heaven
Maudgalyayana.fact: Varying accounts in the Pali Canon show Maudgalyāyana travelling to and speaking with pretas (spirits in unhappy destinations) in order to explain to them their horrific conditions. Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In summary, _____āyana's meditative insights and psychic powers are not only to his own benefit, but benefit the public at large
Maudgalyayana.fact: Similarly, Maudgalyāyana is depicted as conversing with devas and brahmas (heavenly beings), and asking devas what deeds they did to be reborn in heaven. Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In the words of historian _____, he guides others "by providing a cosmological and karmic map of samsara"

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: One day some monks are making noise as they were sitting in the same building as the _____
Maudgalyayana.fact: One day some monks are making noise as they were sitting in the same building as the Buddha. Many of his demonstrations of psychic powers are an indirect means of establishing the Buddha as a great teacher.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Many of his demonstrations of psychic powers are an indirect means of establishing the _____ as a great teacher

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: But the most-quoted example of _____āyana's demonstration of psychic powers is his victory over the dragon (naga) Nandopananda, which requires mastery of the jhānas (states in meditation)

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Upon arrival, he encountered a remarkable sight: a planet inhabited by beings approximately 80 times larger than humans on _____
Maudgalyayana.fact: Upon arrival, he encountered a remarkable sight: a planet inhabited by beings approximately 80 times larger than humans on Earth.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Apart from being used to illustrate the principles of karmic retribution and rebirth, in _____, the story developed a new emphasis
Maudgalyayana.fact: Apart from being used to illustrate the principles of karmic retribution and rebirth, in China, the story developed a new emphasis. Its earliest version being the Sanskrit Ullambana Sutra, the story has been made popular in China, Japan, and Korea through edifying folktales such as the Chinese bianwen (for example, The Transformation Text on Mu-lien Saving His Mother from the Dark Regions).

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In most versions of the story, _____āyana uses his psychic powers to look for his deceased parents and see in what world they have been reborn
Maudgalyayana.fact: There Maudgalyāyana was called "Mulian", and his story was taught in a mixture of religious instruction and entertainment, to remind people of their duties to deceased relatives. In most versions of the story, Maudgalyāyana uses his psychic powers to look for his deceased parents and see in what world they have been reborn.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Although he can find his father in a heaven, he cannot find his mother and asks the _____ for help
Maudgalyayana.fact: Although he can find his father in a heaven, he cannot find his mother and asks the Buddha for help. The Buddha brings him to his mother, who is in a hell realm, but Maudgalyāyana cannot help her.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The Buddha brings him to his mother, who is located in a hell realm, but _____āyana cannot help her
Maudgalyayana.fact: In most versions of the story, Maudgalyāyana uses his psychic powers to look for his deceased parents and see in what world they have been reborn. The Buddha brings him to his mother, who is in a hell realm, but Maudgalyāyana cannot help her.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In the _____ version of the story, he travels to the world of Yama, the ruler of the underworld, only to find the world abandoned
Maudgalyayana.fact: In the Laotian version of the story, he travels to the world of Yama, the ruler of the underworld, only to find the world abandoned.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Yama then tells _____āyana that he allows the denizens of the hell to go out of the gates of hell to be free for one day, that is, on the full moon day of the ninth lunar month
Maudgalyayana.fact: The Buddha brings him to his mother, who is in a hell realm, but Maudgalyāyana cannot help her. Yama then tells Maudgalyāyana that he allows the denizens of the hell to go out of the gates of hell to be free for one day, that is, on the full moon day of the ninth lunar month.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In some other _____ accounts, Maudgalyāyana finds his mother, reborn as a hungry ghost
Maudgalyayana.fact: In some other Chinese accounts, Maudgalyāyana finds his mother, reborn as a hungry ghost.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: (see § _____) Several scholars have pointed out the similarities between the accounts of Maudgalyāyana helping his mother and the account of Phra Malai, an influential legend in Thailand and Laos
Maudgalyayana.fact: (see § Heritage) Several scholars have pointed out the similarities between the accounts of Maudgalyāyana helping his mother and the account of Phra Malai, an influential legend in Thailand and Laos.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Indeed, in some traditional accounts _____ is compared to Maudgalyāyana
Maudgalyayana.fact: (see § Heritage) Several scholars have pointed out the similarities between the accounts of Maudgalyāyana helping his mother and the account of Phra Malai, an influential legend in Thailand and Laos. Indeed, in some traditional accounts Phra Malai is compared to Maudgalyāyana.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: On a similar note, _____āyana's account is also thought to have influenced the Central Asian Epic of King Gesar, Maudgalyāyana being a model for the king
Maudgalyayana.fact: (see § Heritage) Several scholars have pointed out the similarities between the accounts of Maudgalyāyana helping his mother and the account of Phra Malai, an influential legend in Thailand and Laos. Indeed, in some traditional accounts Phra Malai is compared to Maudgalyāyana.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The account relates that the _____ pays a visit to the Trāyastriṃśa Heaven (Pali: Tāvatiṃsa) to teach his mother
Maudgalyayana.fact: The account relates that the Buddha pays a visit to the Trāyastriṃśa Heaven (Pali: Tāvatiṃsa) to teach his mother. King Udāyana misses the Buddha so much that he asks Maudgalyāyana to use his psychic powers to transport thirty-two craftsmen to the heaven, and make an image of the Buddha there.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The image that is eventually made is from sandalwood, and many accounts have attempted to relate it to later _____ images in other areas and countries

King Udāyana misses the Buddha so much that he asks Maudgalyāyana to use his psychic powers to transport thirty-two craftsmen to the heaven, and make an image of the Buddha there.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Although the traditional accounts mentioned state that the Udāyana _____ was the first image, there were probably several Buddha images preceding the Udāyana Buddha, made by both kings and commoners
Maudgalyayana.fact: The account relates that the Buddha pays a visit to the Trāyastriṃśa Heaven (Pali: Tāvatiṃsa) to teach his mother. King Udāyana misses the Buddha so much that he asks Maudgalyāyana to use his psychic powers to transport thirty-two craftsmen to the heaven, and make an image of the Buddha there.

The image that is eventually made is from sandalwood, and many accounts have attempted to relate it to later Buddha images in other areas and countries.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The Pali tradition states that Jain monks persuade a group of robbers led by a Samaṇa-guttaka to kill _____āyana, out of jealousy for his success

Maudgalyāyana often teaches about the visits he has made to heaven and hell, the fruits of leading a moral life, and the dangers of leading an immoral life.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: At that time, _____āyana dwells alone in a forest hut
Maudgalyayana.fact: Maudgalyāyana often teaches about the visits he has made to heaven and hell, the fruits of leading a moral life, and the dangers of leading an immoral life. Whoever kills Maudgalyāyana, the general agreement among different accounts is that he is killed in a violent fashion at the Kālasilā Cave, on the Isigili Hill near Rājagaha, which might be equated with modern Udaya Hill.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: They leave and return on the following day, for six consecutive days, with _____āyana escaping from them in the same way

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In some accounts, he then returns to _____ and dies there, teaching his family before dying
Maudgalyayana.fact: In some accounts, he then returns to Kalasila and dies there, teaching his family before dying.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In other accounts, he dies in the _____'s presence
Maudgalyayana.fact: Maudgalyāyana's great physical and mental strength is such that he is able to regain consciousness and is able to journey to the Buddha. In other accounts, he dies in the Buddha's presence.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: It is described that in a previous life, _____āyana is the only son born to his family
Maudgalyayana.fact: Maudgalyāyana's great physical and mental strength is such that he is able to regain consciousness and is able to journey to the Buddha. It is described that in a previous life, Maudgalyāyana is the only son born to his family.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: In another version recorded in the commentary to the Pali Jātaka, _____āyana does not carry the murder through though, touched by the words of his parents
Maudgalyayana.fact: In another version recorded in the commentary to the Pali Jātaka, Maudgalyāyana does not carry the murder through though, touched by the words of his parents. After Maudgalyāyana's death, people ask why Maudgalyāyana had not protected himself, and why a great enlightened monk would suffer such a death.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Further, the _____ states that even psychic powers will be of no use in avoiding karma, especially when it is serious karma
Maudgalyayana.fact: The Buddha then says that because Maudgalyāyana has contracted such karma in a previous life (the murder of one's own parents is one of the five heinous acts that reap the worst karma), so he could not avoid reaping the consequences. Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Shortly after having left _____āyana for dead, the bandits are all executed
Maudgalyayana.fact: The Buddha then says that because Maudgalyāyana has contracted such karma in a previous life (the murder of one's own parents is one of the five heinous acts that reap the worst karma), so he could not avoid reaping the consequences. Shortly after having left Maudgalyāyana for dead, the bandits are all executed.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Indologist Richard Gombrich raises the example of the murder to prove another point: he points out that _____āyana is able to attain enlightenment, despite his heavy karma from a past life
Maudgalyayana.fact: Shortly after having left Maudgalyāyana for dead, the bandits are all executed. Religious Studies scholar James McDermott therefore concludes that there must have been "a confluence" of karma between Maudgalyāyana and the bandits, and cites the killing as evidence that in Buddhist doctrine the karma of different individuals can interact.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: This, he says, shows that the _____ teaches everyone can attain enlightenment in the here and now, rather than enlightenment necessarily being a gradual process built up through many lifetimes
Maudgalyayana.fact: This, he says, shows that the Buddha teaches everyone can attain enlightenment in the here and now, rather than enlightenment necessarily being a gradual process built up through many lifetimes.

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: Gifford speculates that _____āyana believes he is experiencing heavy karma from a past life
Maudgalyayana.fact: Religious Studies scholar James McDermott therefore concludes that there must have been "a confluence" of karma between Maudgalyāyana and the bandits, and cites the killing as evidence that in Buddhist doctrine the karma of different individuals can interact. Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Maudgalyayana.question: The Ullambana Sutra is the main Mahāyāna sūtra in which _____āyana's rescue of his mother is described (see § Rescuing his mother)

Maudgalyayana.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
